description: This file implements the DateFieldRenderer class responsible for rendering date fields into RTF format within the MigraDoc document processing library. It handles formatting, localization, and conversion of date format patterns to RTF-specific syntax.

classes.name: DateFieldRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering date fields to RTF format, including handling format translation based on culture and date patterns.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Renders the date field to RTF, writing the appropriate RTF tags and formatted date.

methods.name: GetEffectiveFormat
methods.description: Determines the effective date and time format string based on the Document's culture and specified format.

methods.name: TranslateFormat
methods.description: Converts the format string into RTF-specific syntax, handling culture-specific date/time patterns and custom format characters.

methods.name: TranslateCustomFormatChar
methods.description: Converts custom date format characters into RTF-compatible representations.

methods.name: GetFieldResult
methods.description: Returns the current date/time as a string formatted according to the effective format.
